Definition: a bracelet or arm-clasp; generally, a lid
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsâmîyd is the word for a bracelet or arm-clasp. It appears 7 times in Scripture, including Genesis 24:22 and Genesis 24:47.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsâmîyd is no accident in Scripture — God put it there on purpose.
